fact: A Bpifrance-financed supercomputer of about 320 teraflops operates at the Cité du savoir in Diamniadio, and the Senegal AI Factory, a national computing and applied research infrastructure, was presented in Tokyo in August 2026 with no budget, power or timetable published (NET&PRO, 6 September 2026).
title: IA au Sénégal : le pari de la souveraineté
